scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday evening’s offsite report-writing block compatible with the saved ergonomic setup, rather than turning it into laptop-only work.
Emerging Need: The block becomes necessary and moves to a library room that supplies no keyboard, while the required purple-sleeve split keyboard is not at home and school access is closing.
Decision Context: A saved ergonomics checklist identifies when that keyboard matters and where it is normally kept; current calendar, message, and facilities updates determine whether retrieval remains feasible.
Consequence: Once the corridor lockout begins, the missing peripheral cannot be collected before the library reservation, though the writing session itself has not started.

parameter.title: Midyear report catch-up placeholder
parameter.description: Tentative evening hold only if daytime paperwork time is lost; location not set.

parameter.subject: Midyear report batch timing
parameter.body: The midyear report portal closes Friday, Jan. 30 at noon. Wednesday planning-period access will be unavailable for maintenance, so longer updates should be finished during the Thursday evening window if they are not completed earlier.

parameter.title: Central Library study room reservation for report writing
parameter.description: Confirmed laptop documentation block. Reservation notes list Wi-Fi, power, table, and shared monitor only; personal peripherals must be brought at check-in.

parameter.content: I put your laptop charger by the door, but I did not find the purple sleeve anywhere at home or in the car.

parameter.title: Hamilton classroom corridor access cutoff
parameter.description: Facilities notice: therapy-room and classroom corridors lock at 3:45 PM for water-line repair. Personal items must be removed before the cutoff; reopening is Friday morning.

parameter.subject: Classroom corridor lockout underway
parameter.body: The water-line repair lockout has started. Therapy-room and classroom corridors will remain locked until Friday at 7:00 AM, and personal item pickup is no longer available today or Thursday.
